title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 15g (DE) · „Meine Tochter hat es zuerst gemerkt“ – Tischbein-Narration (re-rolls)

shots.h3_prompt: After the bite she chews gently with relaxed lips and a soft smile, then lifts the fork again for a second small bite before the end. Close on her as she bites into a piece of golden, crispy crackling held on her fork, eyes closed with pleasure. First she bites the crackling off the fork with a firm crunch and draws the fork away, eyes closed with pleasure; then she keeps chewing slowly with a blissful smile, her teeth and jaw natural. Static camera. One continuous shot from this first frame with the same people, faces, clothing and setting; no new people, no extra hands, no text or logos appearing anywhere.
shots.rr_why: Bite at 0.4-1.4 s is good, but from ~1.6 s she chews with tightly pursed lips and a bulging, collapsed chin (toothless-looking mouth) until the end - wrong message for a denture ad.
